subject: Conflicting exec travel — convert walkthrough to recording + 30m live follow-up
content:
From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@voyanthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@voyanthealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo on Dec 15 — exec travel conflict

Marissa —

Quick note: our CPO just got pulled into an EMEA trip and will be unavailable the 15th afternoon. We still want the walkthrough — can we shift to the 16th morning PT? If not, could we get a short recorded demo + a live 30m Q&A later? Procurement is watching timelines closely.

Liam
Liam O'Neil
VP Product, Voyant Health
liam.oneil@voyanthealth.com

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@voyanthealth.com>
Cc: procurement@voyanthealth.com; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo on Dec 15 — exec travel conflict

Thanks for the heads up, Liam. Appreciate the signal on timing. Two quick options that keep the evaluation moving:

1) Convert the scheduled 60m walkthrough on Dec 15 into an edited recorded demo (we can time-box to 25–30m covering architecture, latency/cost examples, and the MAP touchpoints) plus a live 30m Q&A the week after (we'll make sure an SE is available for technical questions).

2) Move the full live session to Dec 16 morning PT — I can ask a coverage SE to join but Karthik flagged potential calendar constraints on our side (we have an internal offsite).

Given procurement timelines, option 1 keeps momentum without forcing an exact live window. If you want the recording, I can share a plan and edited timeline by EOD Monday.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-demo-recording-plan.pdf]

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@voyanthealth.com>
Cc: procurement@voyanthealth.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Demo on Dec 15 — exec travel conflict

Hey both —

If we go recorded + live Q&A, I can prepare a short appendix that dives into inferred tail-latency behavior and our batching recommendations for your workload (I saw the MAP notes). Connor can take the live follow-up if I'm tied to the offsite.

I prefer the recording route to avoid rolling scheduling friction — plus we can A/B two prompt sets in the recording to show quality tradeoffs quickly.

Karthik

Subject: RE: Demo on Dec 15 — exec travel conflict

I can own the live 30m Q&A follow-up. Happy to run the session and jump into anything deep on throughput/latency and routing policies. Marissa — if we do the recording, can you share the planned script/timestamps so I can prep the Q&A?

Connor O'Brien

Subject: RE: Demo on Dec 15 — exec travel conflict

Perfect — thanks Connor. Liam, sounds like you're leaning towards the recorded + live Q&A approach. If that's the case, I'll record a focused 28-minute walkthrough that maps to the Mutual Action Plan (attachment), then we'll schedule a 30-minute live Q&A for Dec 20 at 11:00 AM PT (Connor to lead). If Dec 20 doesn't work for your execs, tell me a few windows and we'll adapt.

Action items:
- Marissa: deliver edited recording + timestamps + MAP references by Mon EOD (Dec 15) — [Attachment: redwood-demo-recording-plan.pdf]
- Karthik: add latency appendix and prompt-set comparison to recording materials by Tue noon (Dec 16)
- Connor: own 30m Q&A on Dec 20 11:00 AM PT (tentative)
- Liam / Procurement: confirm Dec 20 or propose alternatives; confirm if procurement needs a redline/contract draft to align timing

Attachments included: mutual_action_plan_voyant.xlsx (MAP)

Thanks all — we should keep momentum here and avoid a multi-day push on scheduling.

Marissa Cole
